situation: How to negotiate better during workplace promotion discussions.
advice:
Do this:
Base your workplace negotiation on the value you create, not your past pay. When management or HR hesitates on your compensation expectations, shift the focus immediately. Try saying: "I completely understand your concern, but my current pay reflects my previous scope, not the value I can create in this new role. I request that we align this with current market standards and the responsibilities of this position." (Negotiating Salary Based on Value Not Past Pay [3]).
